title: The Seven Spiritual Laws Of Success

questions.q: What is the first lesson about handling difficult people?
a: Accept the struggle and find the lesson
questions.why: Accepting the situation teaches a lesson.

questions.q: Which technique does the book suggest for manifesting desires?
questions.why: Direct positive intentions to achieve goals.

questions.q: What does the author say about finding life's purpose?
a: Let it find you, don't chase it
questions.why: Let your purpose find you instead of struggling.

questions.q: Which philosophy blend does the book combine?
What is the main benefit of positive thinking according to the book?
questions.why: Positive thinking leads to self‑fulfilling prophecy.
